capability_envelope: Text-only role for case responses. Files read only to load benchmark inputs and skill references; no browsing or external actions. Responses saved by execution harness.
conditions: One separate agent context per arm, shared context across cases within arm; inherited GPT-6-based Codex model, exact model/build unavailable. Single sample per case; synthetic user messages.
baseline_instruction: Help the user create or improve a reusable agent skill. Ask clarifying questions when needed; otherwise produce useful SKILL.md content, an example and validation guidance. Preserve stated constraints and be honest about tools and evidence. For direct domain tasks, perform the request using supplied information.
limitations: Not a native host discovery test
No repeated samples or significance claims
candidate_source_note: Executor confirms question library read before q-destination addition. Core unchanged; no helpers executed by model arms.
domain_baseline_note: Four generated-skill domain cases regenerated by a fresh child without skill sources; existing skill uses before source.
prompt_variant_note: Direct baseline instruction in this manifest differs slightly in wording from rubric exemplar, same intended task and constraints.
